description:

•Oil- 1 tbsp

Oil for deep frying

Preparation:

•Take small pieces of chicken, wash it well and keep it to drain.
•Add all the items indicated for pakora mix to the chicken and mix well.
•Set aside for around 2 hrs. 

Process:
•Heat oil in a skillet or deep pan and when the oil is medium hot, add the chicken pieces so as not to crowd the pan. Turn them after around 2-3 mins on medium heat and then keep stirring them while frying for another 6-7 mins. Fry till they are uniformly browned.
•Remove the pieces onto a plate.
•Fry the balance chicken pieces and repeat the same process.

title: Tasty Masala Egg Curry | Egg Curry
description:
Written recipe for Masala Egg Curry

Ingredients:
•Boiled eggs
•Oil 3tsp
•Turmeric 1/2 tsp
•whole spices
1. Cumin seeds(jeera) 1 tsp
2. Cloves 3-4 no’s.
3. Cinnamon 1 inch
4. Whole red chilli 1 no.
5. Cardamon 2-3 no’s.
•Onion 3-4 medium size(chopped)
•Ginger garlic paste 2tsp
•Tomato puree of 3-4 medium size tomatos
•Green chilli
•Powdered spices:
1. Turmeric powder 1/2 tsp
2.Coriander powder 1 tsp
3.Red chilli powder
•Salt to taste
•Hot water as required
•Garam masala 1tsp
•Kasuri methi 1tsp
•Fresh coriander

Methods
• Poke the boiled eggs with a toothpick.
• Set a pan on medium heat, add oil and turmeric powder, shallow fry the poked boiled eggs from all sides until the outer layer is crispy. Remove it on an plate.
• For the gravy preparation, set a pan on medium heat, add oil and whole spices and sauté it for minute.
• Add the onions and cook until light golden brown, add ginger garlic paste and sauté for about 1-2 minutes.
• Add tomato puree and green chillies, cook until oil separates, add powdered spices and mix well, cook for 2-3 minutes.
• Add salt to taste and add little hot water if the masala gets too dry, mix well and cook for 5-6 minutes.
• You can adjust the quantity of water depending on how thick or thin you want your masala gravy to be, continue to cook for 5-6 minutes while stirring. Check for seasoning.
• Add the fried eggs to the masala gravy and cook further for 3-4 minutes on medium flame.
• Add garam masala, kasuri methi and freshly chopped coriander leaves, mix well with light hands without damaging the eggs and cook for 2-3 minutes.
• Your egg masala curry is ready to be served, serve hot.
